title: Chicken Tacos
description: Chicken Tacos are made with juicy marinated chicken, smoky roasted salsa, crisp cabbage, and crumbled queso fresco wrapped in warm corn tortillas. Fresh, flavorful, and perfect for a restaurant-quality Mexican meal at home.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs – 500 g (1 lb)
Chili powder – ½ tsp (adjust to taste)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a bowl, mix olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, oregano, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken thighs, coat evenly, and let marinate for at least 1 hour (overnight is ideal for deeper flavor).

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Salsa
steps: Roast tomatoes until slightly charred (oven or stovetop).
Blend roasted tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and salt until smooth. Adjust seasoning to taste.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cook the Chicken
steps: Heat a cast-iron skillet or grill over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken 4–6 minutes per side until fully cooked and slightly charred.
Let rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Warm the Tortillas
steps: Lightly char tortillas on a dry skillet or directly over a flame for 10–15 seconds per side. Keep warm in a clean towel.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Assemble the Tacos
steps: Layer tortillas with sliced chicken, shredded cabbage, a drizzle of crema, and crumbled queso fresco.
Spoon fresh salsa on top and garnish with lime wedges.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately with extra salsa and lime wedges.
Pair with Mexican rice, refried beans, or corn on the cob.
Enjoy with guacamole and tortilla chips for a complete meal.

chefTips: Chicken: Thighs are juicier than breasts; char marks add authentic flavor.
Tortillas: Use fresh, high-quality corn tortillas, and heat them just before serving.
Salsa: Char tomatoes and jalapeño for smoky depth.
Presentation: Serve on a long wooden board or slate with lime wedges and extra salsa on the side.
